newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - June 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - June 9.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Sunday said the armed forces would be engaged in development activities.
Opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) leader Abdul Mannan Bhuiyan on Sunday told a public rally that the ruling Awami League wanted to make Bangladesh a "province of India".
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina leaves for Turkey on Saturday to attend a summit meeting of eight OIC countries to launch a new trade bloc.
Opposition leader Begum Khaleda Zia on Sunday warned that the country's transport sector would be destroyed if India was provided with the transit facility.
Dhaka has lodged a protest with Delhi against the recent violation of Bangladesh air space by an Indian helicopter.
Bangladesh's readymade garments exporters has demanded further devaluation of taka, pegging Taka 50 at one U.S. dollar.
Finance Minister S.A.M.S. Kibria on Sunday criticised the central bank for failing to apply its authority as an autonomous institution.
A Memorandum of Understanding was signed in Dhaka on Sunday to expand trade and economic cooperation between Bangladesh and seven northeastern Indian states.
